blocks.text: 17th sadi (century) ke shuru mein bohat se scientists ne bohat chhoti cheezen dekhne ke liye microscope istemal karna shuru kiya. 1665 mein English scientist Robert Hooke ne oak ke darakht ke cork ka ek patla tukra (slice) microscope ke neeche dekha. Us ne dekha ke cork "bohat se chhote dabbon" (many little boxes) se bana hai. Hooke ne oak ke tanay (stem) aur jar (root) ke tukre bhi dekhe; woh bhi aise hi chhote dabbon se bane the. Us ne nateeja nikala ke poday ke hisse chhote khanon (compartments) se bane hain, aur in khanon ka naam "cellulae" rakha.

blocks.alt: Robert Hooke ki microscope ki drawing: gol base par khambe ke saath laga hua lamba tircha tube, aur objective wale sire ke neeche pin par cork ka tukra. Saath hi cork ki patli qash (slice) ka gol manzar jis mein bohat se chhote, band, dabba numa cells hain jin ki deewarein sanjhi hain.

blocks.text: 1673 mein Dutch scientist Anton van Leeuwenhoek ne behtar microscope banaya aur talaab ke pani mein zinda cells dekhe. Us ne in cells ko animalcules (nanhe janwar) kaha.

1809 mein French biologist Jean Baptiste de-Lamarck ne bhi janwaron aur podon ke hisse microscope se dekhte hue cells dekhe. Phir 1831 mein British botanist (podon ka mahir) Robert Brown ne cell mein nucleus daryaft kiya.

In studies ke baad biologists ne cells ki maloomat ko tarteeb dena shuru kiya. 1838 mein German botanist Matthias Schleiden ne podon ke bohat se hisse microscope se dekhe aur nateeja nikala ke tamam poday cells se bane hain. Agle saal German zoologist (janwaron ka mahir) Theodor Schwann ne janwaron ke liye yehi nateeja nikala. 1855 mein German physician Rudolf Virchow (1821–1902) ne dekha ke tamam cells doosre cells se aate hain. 1862 mein Louis Pasteur ne is khayal ka experimental saboot (tajurbe se saboot) diya. In observations (mushahidon) ko mila kar cells ke bare mein ek bunyadi theory bani jise cell theory kehte hain. Is ke teen zaroori nuqte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Virchow ka saal 1885 likhti hai. Yeh sahi nahi ho sakta, kyun ke isi khayal ka Pasteur wala saboot 1862 ka hai. Virchow ne "har cell kisi cell se aata hai" (omnis cellula e cellula) 1855 mein kaha tha.

items: Tamam jandar ek ya zyada cells se bane hain.
Cells kisi jandar mein structure (banawat) aur function (kaam) ki basic units hain.
Cells sirf pehle se maujood (pre-existing) cells ki division (taqseem) se bante hain.

blocks.text: Validation of Cell Theory (cell theory ki tasdeeq)
Cell theory ko kai observations aur experiments (tajurbon) se sach sabit kiya ja sakta hai. Misal ke taur par:

items: Light microscopes aur electron microscopes se scientists cell ki banawat dekhte hain aur tangible (thos, nazar aane wala) saboot paate hain ke cells waqai tamam jandaron ki structural units hain.

Live-cell imaging (zinda cell ki tasweeren lena) aur genetic studies jaisi techniques se scientists dekh sakte hain ke cells kaise replicate (apni nakal) hote hain aur naye cells banate hain. Is se yeh usool sabit hota hai ke tamam cells pehle se maujood cells se aate hain.

DNA sequencing jaisi techniques dikhati hain ke cells ka genetic material aur metabolic pathways (cell ke andar kimiyai raaste) mushtarak (shared) hain. Is se yeh baat mazboot hoti hai ke cell zindagi ki bunyadi unit hai.

Cell culture studies (lab mein cells ugana) aur tissue engineering jaise experiments cells ka barhna, differentiation (khaas kaam ke cell ban jana) aur reproduction dikha kar cell theory ko sabit karte hain.

blocks.text: Exceptions to Cell Theory (cell theory ke istisna)
Cell theory aam taur par mani jati hai, lekin is ke kuch wazeh exceptions (yani jahan theory poori lagu nahi hoti) hain. Misal ke taur par:

items: Viruses cell theory ko challenge karte hain kyun ke woh cells se nahi bane aur zindagi ke kaam khud nahi kar sakte. Apni nakal banane ke liye unhen host cell (mezban cell) chahiye, aur bohat se scientists unhen zinda aur ghair-zinda ki sarhad par mante hain. Isi tarah prions aur viroids bhi jandar jaisi kuch properties dikhate hain magar cells se nahi bane; woh sirf DNA, RNA ya proteins se bane hain.

Eukaryotic cell ke organelles mitochondria aur chloroplasts ka apna DNA hai aur woh nucleus se alag khud replicate ho sakte hain. Is se lagta hai ke shayad yeh kabhi azaad rehne wale prokaryotic cells the.
Kuch jandaron, jaise kuch fungi aur algae, mein aisi banawat hoti hai jahan ek hi mushtarak cytoplasm mein kai nuclei saath rehte hain. Is se alag alag cell ki hadd (boundary) wazeh nahi rehti.

Vertebrates ke muscle cells (myocytes) aapas mein jur kar kai nuclei wale fibres (multinucleated fibres) bana lete hain. Yeh is khayal ko challenge karta hai ke pecheeda tissues mein ek akela cell hi basic unit hai.

blocks.prompt: Cell theory ke teen nuqte batayen, phir har ek ki himayat (support) mein ek mushahida aur theory ko challenge karne wala ek istisna batayen.
blocks.explanation: Nuqte: tamam jandar cells se bane hain; cell banawat aur kaam ki ikai hai; cells sirf pehle se maujood cells se aate hain. Himayat: microscopy har jandar mein cells dikhati hai; live-cell imaging cells ko cells se taqseem hote dikhati hai; DNA sequencing mushtarak genetic material dikhati hai. Istisnaat: viruses, prions aur viroids cells nahin; mitochondria aur chloroplasts khud replicate hote hain; kai nuclei wale fungi, algae aur jure hue muscle fibres.

items: Hooke (1665) ne cork mein cellulae dekhe; Leeuwenhoek ne zinda cells dekhe; Brown ne nucleus dhunda; Schleiden (poday) aur Schwann (janwar) ne kaha jandar cells se bane hain; Virchow ne kaha cells cells se aate hain; Pasteur ne sabit kiya.
Cell theory: tamam jandar cells se bane hain; cell banawat aur kaam ki ikai hai; cells sirf pehle se maujood cells se bante hain.

Tasdeeq microscopy, live-cell imaging, DNA sequencing aur cell culture se; istisnaat mein viruses, prions, viroids, khud replicate hone wale mitochondria aur chloroplasts, kai nuclei wali banawat aur jure hue muscle fibres shamil hain.
